_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumbnail_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "preview_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "developed_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "trimmed_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "restored_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "dateiformat" TEXT NULL, "file_created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_trashed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_trashed" IN (0, 1)), "trashed_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_locked" IN (0, 1)), "face_scan_excluded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("face_scan_excluded" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL, "width_px" INTEGER NULL, "height_px" INTEGER NULL, "duration_seconds" REAL NULL, "file_size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "backed_up" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("backed_up" IN (0, 1)), "auto_backed_up" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_backed_up" IN (0, 1)), "faces_scanned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("faces_scanned" IN (0, 1)), "linked_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "camera_make" TEXT NULL, "camera_model" TEXT NULL, "lens_model" TEXT NULL, "focal_length_mm" REAL NULL, "f_number" REAL NULL, "iso" INTEGER NULL, "exposure_time_seconds" REAL NULL, "exposure_bias_ev" REAL NULL, "focal_length35mm" REAL NULL, "location_country" TEXT NULL, "location_state" TEXT NULL, "location_city" TEXT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color_label" TEXT NULL, "ocr_text" TEXT NULL, "ocr_scanned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ocr_scanned" IN (0, 1)), "ocr_boxen" TEXT NULL, "gps_geprueft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("gps_geprueft" IN (0, 1)), "datum_geschaetzt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("datum_geschaetzt" IN (0, 1)), "datum_geprueft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("datum_geprueft" IN (0, 1)), "ort_geerbt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ort_geerbt" IN (0, 1)), "videobilder_geprueft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("videobilder_geprueft" IN (0, 1)), "zeitversatz_minuten" INTEGER NULL, "ai_caption" TEXT NULL, "ai_caption_de" TEXT NULL, "ai_caption_scanned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ai_caption_scanned" IN (0, 1)), "ai_caption_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ai_caption_edited" IN (0, 1)), "ai_tags_scanned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ai_tags_scanned" IN (0, 1)), "transkript" TEXT NULL, "transkript_sprache" TEXT NULL, "transkript_geprueft" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("transkript_geprueft" IN (0, 1)), "sharpness_score" REAL NULL, "stack_id" TEXT NULL, "is_stack_cover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_stack_cover" IN (0, 1)), "stack_size" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cover_asset_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_assets" ("album_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("album_id", "asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_tags" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quelle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hand', PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover_face_crop_path" TEXT NULL, "similarity_threshold" REAL NULL, "geburtsdatum" INTEGER NULL, "sterbedatum" INTEGER NULL, "geschlecht" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "faces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NULL, "box_x" REAL NOT NULL, "box_y" REAL NOT NULL, "box_w" REAL NOT NULL, "box_h" REAL NOT NULL, "crop_relative_path" TEXT NULL, "embedding" BLOB NULL, "eye_open_score" REAL NULL, "schaerfe" REAL NULL, "is_ignored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_ignored" IN (0, 1)), "vorschlag_person_id" TEXT NULL, "vorschlag_wert" REAL NULL, "vorschlag_geprueft_am" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "face_match_feedback" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "face_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "accepted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("accepted" IN (0, 1)), "similarity" REAL NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "image_embeddings" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vector" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "performed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "destination_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "privacy_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NULL, "pin_salt" TEXT NULL, "kdf_salt" BLOB NULL, "wrapped_master_key_nonce" BLOB NULL, "wrapped_master_key" BLOB NULL, "protect_metadata" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("protect_metadata" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kdf_salt" BLOB NULL, "wrapped_master_key_nonce" BLOB NULL, "wrapped_master_key" BLOB NULL, "auto_backup_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_backup_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "auto_backup_destination" TEXT NULL, "auto_backup_interval_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, "last_auto_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, "auto_backup_max_mb_per_run" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_searches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "filters_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trash_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "auto_delete_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_delete_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "auto_delete_after_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "last_purge_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "duplikat_ausnahmen" ("asset_a" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_b" TEXT NOT NULL, "angelegt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_a", "asset_b"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "camera_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "camera_make" TEXT NOT NULL, "camera_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_album_id" TEXT NULL, "auto_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "camera_preset_tags" ("preset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("preset_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "develop_settings" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exposure" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "temperature" REAL NULL, "tint" REAL NULL, "contrast" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "shadows" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "highlights" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sharpness" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "noise_reduction" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lens_correction_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("lens_correction_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "clarity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vignette" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lut_path" TEXT NULL, "lut_strength" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "tone_curve_json" TEXT NULL, "color_mixer_json" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "develop_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exposure" REAL NOT NULL, "temperature" REAL NULL, "tint" REAL NULL, "contrast" REAL NOT NULL, "shadows" REAL NOT NULL, "highlights" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sharpness" REAL NOT NULL, "noise_reduction" REAL NOT NULL, "lens_correction_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("lens_correction_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "clarity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vignette" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lut_path" TEXT NULL, "lut_strength" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "tone_curve_json" TEXT NULL, "color_mixer_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "video_trims" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_seconds" REAL NOT NULL, "end_seconds" REAL NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "develop_masks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mask_relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "exposure" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "temperature" REAL NULL, "tint" REAL NULL, "contrast" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "shadows" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "highlights" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sharpness" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "noise_reduction" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lens_correction_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("lens_correction_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "shape_definition_json" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "restore_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "tiles_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tiles_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "sprache" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "auto_analyze_after_import" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_analyze_after_import" IN (0, 1)), "watched_folder_path" TEXT NULL, "watched_folder_token" TEXT NULL, "face_similarity_threshold" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.363, "kartenansicht" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dunkel', "carto_schluessel" TEXT NULL, "eigene_karte_name" TEXT NULL, "eigene_karte_url" TEXT NULL, "eigene_karte_nennung" TEXT NULL, "eigene_karte_stufe" INTEGER NULL, "eigene_karte_zugestimmt" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("eigene_karte_zugestimmt" IN (0, 1)), "karte_hochaufloesend" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("karte_hochaufloesend" IN (0, 1)), "gelaende_stimmung_nr" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "gelaende_grund_nr" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "gelaende_wege" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("gelaende_wege" IN (0, 1)), "gelaende_beschriftung" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("gelaende_beschriftung" IN (0, 1)), "gelaende_hoehenlinien" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("gelaende_hoehenlinien" IN (0, 1)), "gelaende_wanderobjekte" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("gelaende_wanderobjekte" IN (0, 1)), "schwebe_vorschau" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("schwebe_vorschau" IN (0, 1)), "stammbaum_ansicht" TEXT NULL, "stammbaum_person" TEXT NULL, "lebensbaum_richtung" TEXT NULL, "lebensbaum_stil" TEXT NULL, "lebensbaum_generationen" INTEGER NULL, "lebensbaum_familie_oben" INTEGER NULL, "lebensbaum_familie_unten" INTEGER NULL, "lebensbaum_familie_kreis" TEXT NULL, "zeitleiste_kachelstufe" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "zeitleiste_form_nr" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "zeitleiste_sortierung_nr" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "zeitleiste_mit_tagen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("zeitleiste_mit_tagen" IN (0, 1)), "listenspalten" TEXT NULL, "max_gleichzeitig" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "translate_captions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("translate_captions" IN (0, 1)), "translate_search_and_tags" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("translate_search_and_tags" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_tag_vocabulary" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "term" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "automation_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "region_center_lat" REAL NULL, "region_center_lon" REAL NULL, "region_radius_km" REAL NULL, "ai_tag_term" TEXT NULL, "date_from" INTEGER NULL, "date_to" INTEGER NULL, "target_album_id" TEXT NULL, "auto_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_favorite" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "automation_rule_tags" ("rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("rule_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "develop_presets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "exposure" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "temperature" REAL NULL, "tint" REAL NULL, "contrast" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "shadows" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "highlights" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sharpness" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "noise_reduction" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lens_correction_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("lens_correction_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "clarity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vignette" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "lut_path" TEXT NULL, "lut_strength" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "tone_curve_json" TEXT NULL, "color_mixer_json" TEXT NULL, "erstellt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "export_presets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "nach_jpeg" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("nach_jpeg" IN (0, 1)), "max_kante" INTEGER NULL, "qualitaet" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.9, "namensmuster" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{name}', "xmp_daneben" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("xmp_daneben" IN (0, 1)), "erstellt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_beziehungen" ("person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "andere_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("person_id", "andere_id", "art"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lebensereignisse" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL, "datum" INTEGER NULL, "ort" TEXT NULL, "notiz" TEXT NULL, "ort_breite" REAL NULL, "ort_laenge" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reisen" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "von" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bis" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notiz" TEXT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reise', "titelbild_asset_id" TEXT NULL, "angelegt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reise_aufnahmen" ("reise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("reise_id", "asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reisetagnotizen" ("reise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notiz" TEXT NOT NULL, "geaendert_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("reise_id", "tag"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verworfene_reisen" ("schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "verworfen_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schluessel"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ortsmarken" ("art" TEXT NOT NULL, "schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "breite" REAL NULL, "laenge" REAL NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notiz" TEXT NULL, "angelegt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("art", "schluessel"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "aktivitaeten" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL, "von" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bis" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notiz" TEXT NULL, "reise_id" TEXT NULL, "angelegt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "aktivitaet_aufnahmen" ("aktivitaet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("aktivitaet_id", "asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verworfene_aktivitaeten" ("schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "verworfen_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schluessel"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spuren" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quelle" TEXT NOT NULL, "aktivitaet_id" TEXT NULL, "reise_id" TEXT NULL, "von" INTEGER NULL, "bis" INTEGER NULL, "punktzahl" INTEGER NOT NULL, "laenge_km" REAL NOT NULL, "aufstieg" REAL NULL, "abstieg" REAL NULL, "angelegt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spurpunkte" ("spur_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nummer" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breite" REAL NOT NULL, "laenge" REAL NOT NULL, "hoehe" REAL NULL, "zeit" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("spur_id", "nummer"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verworfene_serien" ("schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "verworfen_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schluessel"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verworfene_ortsvorschlaege" ("schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "verworfen_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schluessel"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "videoeinbettungen" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stelle" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vector" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "stelle"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ergebnisherkunft" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "art" TEXT NOT NULL, "modell" TEXT NOT NULL, "geraet" TEXT NOT NULL, "beschleuniger" TEXT NOT NULL, "zeit" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "art"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wanderpunkte" ("osm_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "art_nr" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breite" REAL NOT NULL, "laenge" REAL NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "hoehe" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("osm_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wanderabfragen" ("kasten" TEXT NOT NULL, "gefragt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kasten"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verworfene_dokumente" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "verworfen_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gemerkte_erinnerungen" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "titel" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asset_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "gemerkt_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "aufgabenlaeufe" ("schluessel" TEXT NOT NULL, "fertig_am" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schluessel"));
